repos.name: Langgraph4-Langchain-vs-Langgraph

repos.name: Langgraph9-Iterative-Workflow

repos.name: Langgraph10-Basic-Chatbot

repos.name: L15-RAG-Langchain
repos.description: This module shows an end-to-end RAG pipeline for querying YouTube transcripts. It downloads captions via yt-dlp, chunks text, builds embeddings, and stores vectors in Chroma. A retriever and LLM form a QA chain, providing grounded answers with reproducible steps for learning and experimentation.

repos.name: Langgraph6-Sequential-Workflow
repos.description: This lesson demonstrates how to implement sequential workflows using LangGraph, where tasks are executed in a specific order with state flowing from one step to the next. You’ll practice building linear pipelines, chaining prompts, and transforming state across steps.

repos.name: Langgraph3-AgenticAI-Intro
repos.description: This lesson provides a comprehensive introduction to Agentic AI, covering fundamental concepts, architecture patterns, and the theoretical foundations that enable AI systems to act autonomously.

repos.name: L11-DocumentLoader
repos.description: This lesson explores LangChain document loading: ingesting files, web pages, and API data into Documents for downstream retrieval. Notebooks demonstrate loaders, metadata handling, chunk boundaries, and basic preprocessing to prepare heterogeneous sources for embeddings, indexing, and RAG pipelines, and evaluation.

repos.name: L13-VectorStore-Langchain
repos.description: This module demonstrates how to build a reusable vector store with LangChain and Chroma. You will create embeddings for documents, index them into a Chroma database, run similarity search/top-k retrieval, and persist the store to `store/` so it can be reloaded without re-indexing in later sessions.

repos.name: L12-TextSplitter-Langchain
repos.description: This lesson covers text chunking for retrieval. You’ll compare recursive, fixed, and semantic splitters, tune chunk size and overlap, preserve metadata boundaries, and evaluate downstream effects on embeddings, recall, and latency to build reliable, efficient RAG pipelines from heterogeneous documents.

repos.name: Langgraph1-Curriculam

repos.name: L14-Retriever-Langchain
repos.description: Learn and compare LangChain retrieval methods—MMR, multi-query, contextual compression, hybrid, and re-ranking. Use notebooks ex1–ex5 with sample data and persisted stores to build strong, efficient retrieval for production-grade RAG and evaluation.

repos.name: L8-Output-Parser-LangchainX
repos.description: Practical guide to LangChain output parsers. Convert raw LLM text into structured, validated data (JSON, lists, tables) with schemas, robust error handling, and retries. Build reliable pipelines that downstream tools can trust and automate.

repos.name: L9-Chain-Langchain
repos.description: Hands-on notebooks for composing LangChain pipelines ("chains") that connect prompts, LLMs, tools, and output parsers. Learn when to use linear (sequential) flows versus map-reduce strategies for multi-document or batched inputs, and how to evaluate trade-offs in latency, cost, and output quality.

repos.name: L10-Runnable-Langchain
repos.description: This lesson shows how to build flexible, reusable LangChain pipelines using `Runnable` building blocks. Learn to compose steps, pass state, fan‑out/fan‑in, and instrument/debug flows for production‑ready chains.
